questions.question: How does the refractive index changes with wave length ?

answers.a: Increase with increase in wave length
answers.b: Decrease with increase in wave length

questions.question: If the velocity of incident ray is less than the velocity of transmitted ray through a medium. Then angle of refraction is _______

answers.d: There is no angle of refraction.
